Unfortunate, not irreversible bereavement; separate later accusation by Kyrgylchal remains intact. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation.
